_doc: Corrections to data/catalog.json, by catalogue id; they always win over the sources. Typical uses: {"<id>": {"gog": "https://www.gog.com/en/game/..."}} for a missing or wrong shop link; {"<id>": {"status": "record"}} to keep a game as record only; {"<id>": {"editions": {"<edition key>": {"rights": "permission", "rightsSource": "<link to the written permission>"}}}} when the rights holder allows it to run on the web, or {"run": {"exe": "GAME/START.BAT", "cycles": 20000}} to fix how it starts. Never mark as playable a game without evidence that it may be distributed: 'abandonware' is not a licence.
